items.title: CVE-2021-21551: Dell dbutil denial of service and privilege escalation in kernel driver (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Dell dbutil driver, which Dell update and support tools install on Windows Dell computers, lets an attacker who already has a low-privilege local account escalate privileges, crash the system, or access information they shouldn't. Attacks using this bug are happening, according to CISA's list of known exploited vulnerabilities.

items.summary: In mid-2024, a set of malformed DNG image files carrying a fully-featured Android spyware were uploaded to VirusTotal from Iraq, Iran, and Morocco. items.title: CVE-2026-20182: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller authentication bypass in fabric management plane (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager have an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker over the network, without logging in, sign in as an internal high-privileged user and use NETCONF to change the SD-WAN fabric's network configuration. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Guardrail Sandbox Escape RCE
items.summary: What is the Vulnerability? CVE-2026-40217 is a critical arbitrary-code-execution vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM, a widely used open-source LLM proxy/gateway. LiteLLM's guardrail feature includes a "test custom code" facility that runs user-supplied guardrail code in a sandbox. The sandbox can be escaped by rewriting Python bytecode, allowing an attacker to break out and execute arbitrary code in the context of the LiteLLM process (reported running as root in some deployments). The vector is a request to POST /guardrails/test_custom_code. CVSS is 8.8- the attacker needs minimal low-privilege…

items.title: CVE-2026-4981
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the login interface's OAuth callback endpoint by crafting a malicious URL. This URL, containing unvalidated `error` and `error_uri` parameters, allows the attacker to display arbitrary error messages, leading to content spoofing. Furthermore, the attacker can redirect victims to malicious domains, effectively performing an open redirect under the guise of the trusted application's user interface.

items.title: CVE-2026-137524
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.20.84 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the instance-level SSO sign-in path that hardcodes signup as enabled, ignoring all signup-disable controls. Any user with an account on the configured GitHub or Google identity provider can sign in via the OAuth endpoint to obtain an admin session in a newly created workspace.

items.title: CVE-2026-137499
items.summary: Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137536
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authentication bypass in its server OAuth SSO sign-in module, which resolves Google and Git SSO logins solely by the provider-asserted email without checking email_verified or binding the SSO subject. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a trusted-issuer token carrying a victim's unverified email to the SSO callback to obtain the victim's session, including admin accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137523
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass in instance-level Google SSO because the id_token audience is not verified when no Google OAuth client ID is configured, the shipped default. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a Google-signed id_token minted for their own OAuth client to /api/sso/sign-in/common/google without an organizationId, obtaining a session as any existing user with the matching email.

items.title: CVE-2026-124844
items.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 writes legacy GINA multipart uploads before authenticating the caller and does not remove files created by failed or unauthenticated requests. An unauthenticated remote attacker can accumulate persistent upload files and exhaust the backing filesystem, disrupting GINA and other services sharing that storage.

items.title: CVE-2026-124841
items.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 permits LDAP wildcard characters in legacy GINA identifiers and inserts those values into account, token, certificate, and key lookup filters without escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-124838
items.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 exposes an unauthenticated, world-writable local configuration socket whose root daemon accepts shell commands. An attacker with local low-privilege code execution can execute arbitrary commands as root and take complete control of the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-124837
items.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 copies an insufficiently sanitized DKIM identity into authentication results and may preserve the injected result in an ARC seal. An unauthenticated remote sender can create misleading authentication claims that downstream systems may trust when DKIM verification and ARC sealing are enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-124836
items.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 inserts message-derived values into LDAP filters used by the ldap_compare and ldap_read mail-rule operations without LDAP filter escaping. An unauthenticated remote sender can alter an LDAP-backed rule query when a deployed rule uses attacker-controlled message data, potentially changing policy decisions or exposing data returned to later rule processing.

items.title: CVE-2026-123685
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the patch apply functionality of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux) due to insufficient validation of uploaded patch packages before extraction. An attacker with low-privileged web access can upload a crafted patch package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

items.title: CVE-2026-123682
items.summary: An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the update functionality of StellarOne due to insufficient validation of files contained within uploaded update packages. An attacker with web administrator privileges can upload a crafted update package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123680
items.summary: An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the firmware update functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with admin privileges can upload a crafted firmware package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the system. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-133208
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. A crafted delivery URL places a macro token in the source or target parameter and malicious markup in the referer parameter. Macro replacement after initial input encoding can insert the unescaped markup into generated banner output, causing JavaScript execution in the delivery origin when a visitor follows the URL. An active banner is required.

items.title: CVE-2026-136990
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in TAILG Feimeng up to 20261028. Affected is an unknown function of the component Wireless Remote Control System. The manipulation leads to authentication bypass by capture-replay. The attack needs to be initiated within the local network. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-137307
items.summary: wpa_supplicant 2.7 through 2.12 with the wolfSSL backend contains an EAP-FAST server authentication bypass in tls_sess_sec_cb() that skips master secret derivation for oversized PAC-Opaque tickets. Adjacent attackers running a rogue authenticator can complete the handshake with an all-zero master secret to capture MS-CHAPv2 responses for offline cracking and replace the stored PAC.

items.title: CVE-2026-137306
items.summary: Grav Admin plugin before 1.10.65 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in LoginController::taskForgot() that ignores the Require Trusted Host setting when building reset links. Unauthenticated attackers who know an administrator's username can submit the forgot-password form with a forged Host header, capturing the reset token when clicked to take over accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133211
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a delivery URL that executes JavaScript in the delivery origin when a visitor follows it. An active banner using the raw {clickurl} macro is required.

items.title: CVE-2026-133203
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the public conversion-variable endpoint does not verify that a caller-supplied conversion belongs to the supplied tracker. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a unique variable for a different tracker's conversion, causing that conversion to be classified as a duplicate and excluded from conversion reports.

items.title: CVE-2026-114507
items.summary: LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 1.5.5, query responses are cached under a key that omits conversation_history, so an unauthenticated attacker can poison the cached answers returned to other users who send the same query. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

items.title: Incident Memory: Chronology of an Extortion-as-a-Service Attack (II)
items.summary: In December 2025, the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) at G DATA handled an extortion-as-a-service attack on a mid-sized company. During the attack, data was exfiltrated on a large scale. In the second part of this post, we go into the technical details. The analysis shows that the methods were professional and the approach was less conspicuous than that of an average ransomware group.

items.title: CVE-2019-17563: Apache Tomcat session fixation in FORM authentication (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat has a session fixation flaw in its FORM authentication. A remote attacker, without logging in, could fix a victim's session ID, but the victim must take an action and the window for the attack is narrow.

items.title: CVE-2018-1336: Apache Tomcat denial of service in the UTF-8 decoder (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, from the Apache Software Foundation, mishandles overflow in its UTF-8 decoder when it processes supplementary characters. A remote attacker who does not need to log in can trigger an infinite loop and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2019-0199: Apache Tomcat denial of service in HTTP/2 stream handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat is affected by a flaw in its HTTP/2 handling that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, open streams and keep them open while sending excessive SETTINGS frames and never reading or writing data. This ties up server threads running blocking I/O, which can exhaust them and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2016-6816: Apache Tomcat remote response injection via HTTP request line parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat accepts invalid characters in HTTP request lines, and when paired with a proxy that reads them differently, a remote attacker can inject data into HTTP responses without logging in, though a user action is needed. This can be used to poison a web cache, carry out cross-site scripting, or obtain sensitive information from requests other than the attacker's own, and public exploit c...

items.title: CVE-2026-87719: GitLab credential leak via deserialization in Advanced Search (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GitLab Enterprise Edition, a self-hosted software platform for source code management and DevOps, is affected by this flaw. An authenticated user with access to Duo Chat could potentially view Advanced Search configuration details and sensitive credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-99362: Linux kernel out-of-bounds write in NFSD SEQUENCE reply handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's nfsd server component has a flaw in how it handles SEQUENCE replies with a negotiated small cached reply size. A client can trigger an out-of-bounds write in kernel memory, and the client can read back part of the data written past the end of the buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129182: PHP memory corruption via stale last_fatal_error_backtrace (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free flaw in PHP (from the PHP Group) lets an attacker corrupt memory, crash PHP-FPM or mod_php workers, and possibly run their own code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but only on servers with specific per-path or per-directory configuration, where a fatal error during request shutdown leaves stale data that a later request on the same worker then uses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129481: PHP memory corruption in session shutdown cleanup (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's session extension has a use-after-free flaw: if a fatal error occurs in an application callback during session shutdown, a stale pointer to the script filename can later be freed by another request handled by the same worker. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup could crash the worker or corrupt memory, reaching it remotely without logging in, though it only applies when the...

items.title: CVE-2020-9402: SQL injection in GIS functions and aggregates on Oracle (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Django contains a SQL injection flaw when untrusted data is passed as the tolerance parameter in GIS functions and aggregates on Oracle. An attacker who can log in with low privileges can reach it remotely over the network and inject malicious SQL.

items.title: CVE-2026-133202
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report.

items.title: USN-9206-1: Guava vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that Guava did not correctly handle permissions for certain temporary directories. An attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-8908, CVE-2023-2976) Kaya Emre Arikan discovered that Guava did not correctly handle deserializing certain data. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2026-102554)

items.summary: It was discovered that PyJWT incorrectly handled errors when parsing deeply nested token headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using PyJWT to fail unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-102265) It was discovered that PyJWT modified the options mapping supplied by an application when signature verification was disabled. If an application reused that mapping for a later call with signature verification enabled, an attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass token claim checks, such as expiration. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS…

items.title: CVE-2026-137660
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in stylefeng Guns up to 2.2. Affected by this issue is the function TokenAndPermissionInterceptor.preHandle of the file TokenAndPermissionInterceptor.java of the component JWT Signing. Such manipulation leads to use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-137602
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability enables information disclosure when the parameterized-scopes feature is enabled. The protocol mapper fails to enforce authorization checks for certain scope parameter types during token and authorization requests. An authenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw by supplying a crafted scope parameter to retrieve sensitive profile attributes of other users without authorization.

The file server reserves memory for a named-pipe response using a size chosen by the client. It does not keep that size within the maximum the client and the server have already agreed. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can open a named pipe can request a very large response. The file server reserves that memory before it reads the pipe and holds it until the request ends. Repe…

items.title: CVE-2026-137656
items.summary: LibreChat 0.7.8 before 0.8.9 contains a race condition vulnerability in checkBalance that allows authenticated users to obtain multiple auto-refill credits by sending concurrent requests. Attackers can send simultaneous chat requests that each pass the unlocked lastRefill check, receiving repeated refillAmount credits and bypassing configured token credit limits.

items.title: CVE-2026-137655
items.summary: Video Popup Block by WPZOOM 1.1.2 before 1.1.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject markup via unescaped video URL and popup width values. Attackers can store a block whose .mp4 URL or width breaks out of attributes in frontend.js, executing script in the site's origin when users open the popup.

items.title: CVE-2026-137588
items.summary: LibreChat 0.7.6 before 0.8.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to block the server event loop by uploading a crafted conversation import file to POST /api/convos/import. Attackers can submit many messages with unresolvable parentMessageId values, triggering quadratic processing in cloneMessagesWithTimestamps or adjustTimestampsForOrdering and stalling the Node.js event loop for minutes for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-137539
items.summary: lastversion before 3.6.20 contains a path traversal vulnerability in extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory via tar symlink members. Attackers controlling a project's release assets can craft a tarball with a symlink followed by a file beneath it, writing files like usercustomize.py to achieve code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137529
items.summary: JAL (Just Another Ledger) through 2026.11.3 contains an arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in backup restore that allows attackers to write files by supplying a crafted .tgz backup with a symlink member. Attackers can include a jal.sqlite symlink to an absolute path followed by a regular jal.sqlite member, overwriting files such as shell startup scripts for code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137518
items.summary: pyfda through 0.9.5 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_filter() that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .npz or .pkl filter files. Attackers can embed a __reduce__ gadget that runs via np.load with allow_pickle=True or pickle.load before validation, executing code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137507
items.summary: torchvision before 0.29.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in _extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory by supplying crafted tar archives. Attackers controlling archives passed to extract_archive() or download_and_extract_archive() can use .. paths, absolute paths, or symlinks to overwrite Python modules and achieve code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137506
items.summary: ezdxf through 1.4.5 contains a code injection vulnerability in the dxf2code add-on that allows attackers to inject Python code via unescaped single quotes in DXF table entry names. Attackers can craft a DXF file whose layer, linetype, style, or appid names break out of quoted strings in generated scripts, executing code with the privileges of the user running them.

items.title: CVE-2026-137436
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument room_id results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

On hosts with sufficient free memory, the same technique can instead hold large amounts of memory per connection. Connection and DNS errors from the dial are exposed in a condition readable in the tenant's namespace. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs WP ERP erp allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP ERP: from n/a through 2.0.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-137560
items.summary: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 contain a denial of service vulnerability in RSAKey, which accepts RSA keys with a modulus and public exponent of unbounded length. Remote attackers can supply a crafted key, such as in the jwk header of a DPoP proof, to force seconds of CPU per PS256/PS384/PS512 verification or RSA encryption, or per any RSA operation when GMP is unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-137549
items.summary: pypdf before 7.0.1 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in image loading because data size estimates for some image modes are too low, defeating limits for filters without their own size limit. Attackers can craft a PDF whose images, when loaded, cause large memory usage and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137541
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the QuickDraft Livewire component that allows any authenticated user to create posts without the post.create permission. Attackers such as self-registered Subscriber accounts can submit the dashboard Quick Draft widget to inject draft posts, bypassing the PostPolicy check enforced by PostController.

items.title: CVE-2026-137537
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated End Users to execute data queries of apps in other organizations via POST /api/data-queries/:id/run. Attackers can supply a target data-query id and runtime resolvedOptions to run queries with the datasource's decrypted credentials, reading cross-tenant query results.

items.title: CVE-2026-137532
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-workspace files by requesting a known File UUID. Attackers can request GET /api/files/:id with another workspace's File UUID to retrieve stored file bytes, such as avatars, without parent resource authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137531
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view-only workspace users to execute queries in restricted environments by supplying an arbitrary environmentId. Attackers can call the data-queries run endpoint for draft app versions to execute queries with stored datasource credentials, exposing development or staging data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137521
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to read, modify, or delete other organizations' app-builder components, pages, and events. Attackers can target their own app/version in the URL to pass ValidAppGuard, then supply victim resource ids that services query without appVersionId or organizationId scoping.

items.title: CVE-2026-137519
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Builders with only data source Delete permission to update global data sources via the PUT /api/data-sources endpoint. Attackers can change a REST data source base URL so later query executions send stored Bearer credentials to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-137517
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.8.0 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to modify queries in view-only apps by supplying cross-app query IDs. Attackers can send PATCH requests to /api/data-queries/versions/:versionId naming an editable app version with another app's query ID, then run the overwritten query using that app's data source connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-137512
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass LoopLimit by supplying large JSON input to object.from_json. Attackers can pass a flat JSON array or object with hundreds of thousands of elements, which JsonElementExtensions materializes without loop checks, exhausting CPU and memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137509
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows template authors to bypass LimitToString by rendering a ScriptObject with many members. Attackers can supply a small template whose ScriptObject.ToString concatenates large member values without length tracking, allocating multi-gigabyte strings and causing memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-137495
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the bulkDestroy function that allows authenticated users to delete rows from any workspace table by supplying foreign row IDs. Attackers with TABLE WRITE on one table can send row _id values from other tables to the DELETE /api/:sourceId/rows endpoint, causing data loss and workspace metadata deletion.

items.title: CVE-2026-137491
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.

items.title: CVE-2026-137468
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.8.0 before 3.8.11 contains a lockout bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to brute-force publish passwords by forging client-computable publish-auth- cookies. Attackers can compute SHA-256(ID + candidate) locally and send it on content requests like /api/filetree/getDoc to guess passwords without throttling and read protected documents.

items.title: CVE-2026-137463
items.summary: HKUDS nanobot from 0.1.4 before 0.4.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the OpenAI Codex provider that retries authenticated requests without TLS certificate or hostname verification. Attackers able to intercept the connection can trigger a certificate failure and impersonate the endpoint to steal bearer tokens, read request contents, or alter responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-137411
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. Impacted is the function searchItem of the file application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Dashbord Search. The manipulation of the argument q results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-135280
items.summary: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.14, when an application enables case-insensitive routing, middleware mounted on a path can still be skipped in two cases: a string mount path or plugin prefix containing a Unicode character whose case folding differs from a plain lowercase conversion fails to match the lowercased request path, and a matcher that stays case-sensitive inside an Express Router or application, such as a regular expression without the ignore-case flag or an…

items.title: CVE-2026-135270
items.summary: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.5 before 4.0.14, a mount path that begins with an Express 5 optional leading segment written as a group is treated as relative and has a slash prepended when it is joined to the plugin prefix, which changes what the pattern matches so the middleware ends up mounted on a path that no longer corresponds to the real request paths. The middleware therefore never runs for requests that match the intended routes, while the Fastify routes still…

items.title: CVE-2026-76075
items.summary: The Warehouse Cargo theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in versions up to, and including, 2.7.4 via the warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX handler. The handler is registered on wp_ajax_ but performs no nonce verification and no capability check, allowing any authenticated user to supply an attacker-controlled URL that the server fetches, writes into wp-content/plugins/ with file_put_contents(), extracts with unzip_file() (which does not filter file extensions), and then activates via activate_plugin(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, w…

items.title: CVE-2026-135205
items.summary: @fastify/middie is the plugin that adds Express-style middleware support to the Fastify web framework. In versions 9.3.6 through 9.3.9, a route or mount path written without a leading slash inside a plugin registered under a prefix is handled inconsistently: the middleware is mounted with a separating slash after the prefix, while the route is concatenated directly onto the prefix, so a request to the concatenated path reaches the route handler without running the middleware mounted for it. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affec…

items.title: CVE-2026-137409
items.summary: A flaw has been found in chuckfairy node-webcam up to 0.8.2. This vulnerability affects the function generateSh of the file src/webcams/FSWebcam.js of the component FSWebcam. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-137407
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Max Foundry Media Library Folders Plugin up to 8.4.3 on WordPress. Affected by this issue is the function mlfp_toggle_file_access of the file media-library-plus.php of the component Block Direct Access. Such manipulation of the argument file_id leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. Upgrading to version 8.4.4 can resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-92251
items.summary: The ZarinPal Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 5.1.1 via the `Return_from_ZarinPal_Gateway()` handler registered on the `woocommerce_api_wc_zpal` (`?wc-api=wc_zpal`) endpoint. The handler accepts a `wc_order` parameter from the query string, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order without any authentication, nonce, session, capability, or ownership check, and — when the order is paid — issues a 302 redirect to `get_return_url($order)`, whose `Location` header embeds the order's secret `orde…

items.title: CVE-2026-137563
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

items.title: CVE-2026-137557
items.summary: SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. Attackers can store content whose language- class decodes to HTML written via innerHTML into the hover button, executing script when victims hover over the block.

items.title: CVE-2026-137550
items.summary: Frappe Framework before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Document.update() that fails to validate whether the caller is permitted to submit or modify the target document. Attackers can invoke document update operations to submit or alter documents they are not authorized to change.

items.title: CVE-2026-137546
items.summary: Coder 2.29.17 before 2.29.27, 2.32.7 before 2.33.0, 2.33.8 before 2.34.0, 2.34.2 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious template authors to steal session tokens because coder open app substitutes $SESSION_TOKEN into template-defined external app URLs without validating scheme or destination. Attackers can define an external app URL or IDE link pointing to an attacker server so users running coder open app leak their token, enabling impersonation of shared users or administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-137543
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by abusing the unvalidated ai_ollama_base_url setting. Once a settings.edit user points the Ollama base URL internally, any post.create user can call /admin/ai/generate-seo with provider=ollama to fetch internal data reflected in SEO fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-137538
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse expired JWTs because the passport-jwt strategy sets ignoreExpiration to true. Attackers holding a leaked tj_auth_token can keep sessions alive through auto-extended expiry and two-year cookies to persistently access victim accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137534
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privilege app/query viewers to obtain plaintext workspace secrets by running REST queries. Attackers can execute queries via POST /data-queries/:id/run whose URL params or non-redacted headers reference secrets, reading resolved values from metadata.request despite lacking decrypted constants access.

items.title: CVE-2026-137530
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getVersionsByEnvironment that allows authenticated users to read another organization's application versions due to missing organizationId scoping. Attackers can request the app-environments versions route with their own priority-1 production environment id and a victim app_id to retrieve the victim's version list and structure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137525
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users with TEST_CONNECTION ability to exfiltrate organization secrets by resolving secret placeholders in test-connection options. Attackers can point the host and port at a listener they control and set the password option to a secrets template, causing the server to send the plaintext secret to them.

items.title: CVE-2026-137520
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS is missing the ValidateDataSourceGuard on the dependent-queries route of the data-sources controller and does not scope the datasource lookup to the caller's organization. An authenticated admin or builder with dataSourceDelete can request /api/data-sources/dependent-queries/ to confirm a datasource exists in another organization and learn its dependent-query count.

items.title: CVE-2026-137516
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the StationPublicApi middleware that allows any authenticated user to access non-public stations without per-station permissions. Attackers can change the station_id path parameter to list and download on-demand media, read schedule data, and submit song requests to unauthorized stations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137515
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RelaysController::updateAction that allows any authenticated user to modify shared relays and delete other stations' relay associations. Attackers can POST a relay base_url to /internal/relays to rename the relay, wipe StationRemote rows of unmanaged stations, and spoof public now-playing data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137511
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a state isolation vulnerability because TemplateContext.Reset() does not clear the Tags dictionary holding array.cycle and math.random state. Attackers supplying templates to a reused context can observe or influence cycle positions and random sequences across renders, and accumulate unbounded cycle entries to exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137510
items.summary: Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.6.0 allow template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit because the string.literal, string.base64_encode, html.escape, html.newline_to_br, html.url_encode, and html.url_escape builtins lack allocation guards. An attacker who can supply a small template can repeatedly call these builtins under the default TemplateContext to force multi-gigabyte allocations and exhaust host memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137508
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in object.to_json that allows template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit by serializing into an unbounded MemoryStream. Attackers can repeatedly apply object.to_json to escape-heavy strings in a tiny template, amplifying output to multi-gigabyte heap allocations and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137505
items.summary: actix-http before 3.20.4 contains a response desynchronization vulnerability in its HTTP/1 client response decoder, which reads bodies on 1xx, 204 and 304 responses based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding headers. Servers sending such responses with framing headers cause awc clients to consume subsequent keep-alive responses, causing request failures or misattributing responses across users in proxies.

items.title: CVE-2026-137503
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. Attackers can submit crafted parameters to the queries endpoint to add extra Key entries, deleting chosen S3 objects or overriding Sheets row columns.

items.title: CVE-2026-137405
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected is the function move_uploaded_file of the file /admin/add_food.php of the component File Upload Handler. The manipulation of the argument image/new_image/update_image results in unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-109586
items.summary: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 via the `REQUEST_URI` query parameter. This is due to a parser-differential flaw in `showLoginForm()`: the plugin's `isRestUrl()` function performs an unanchored `strpos()` prefix match against the full `REQUEST_URI` — including the query string — and short-circuits all authorization checks (including `isStagingSite()` and `current_user_can('manage_options')`) whenever it detects a REST-like URL,…

items.title: CVE-2026-137494
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-137492
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.

items.title: CVE-2026-137490
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted subjects to execute arbitrary queries by calling the JavaScript surrealdb.query() bridge. Attackers permitted to run a specific script can bypass the Capabilities::allows_query() gate in the query module to execute unrestricted queries beyond their predefined operations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137489
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the remote HTTP client router that passes raw model names to Url::join during ML export. Attackers can supply an absolute URL as the model name in ExportMl or ExportBytesMl commands to redirect authenticated requests and capture session tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-137488
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read SELECT-hidden edge endpoints through InOverride/OutOverride error messages. Attackers with CREATE and UPDATE permission on an edge table can re-RELATE an existing edge with mismatched endpoints to recover stored in/out record ids despite row- or field-level restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-137487
items.summary: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-unbound through 26.288.56989~75a306d contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the Unbound Configure page inserts the dhcp.odhcpd.leasetrigger value into a warning notification without escaping. Users with delegated network configuration access can store an HTML event handler in that option through the permitted uci RPC, which executes in an administrator's browser session when the page renders.

items.title: CVE-2026-137475
items.summary: vLLM 0.21.0 before 0.28.0, when using the V1 model runner, contains a state aliasing flaw in ThinkingBudgetStateHolder.sync_batch(), whose SWAP branch copies thinking-budget state to the destination batch row without removing the source entry. Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137474
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.8 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that creates workspace directories with mode 0755 and conf.json with mode 0644, exposing the cleartext AccessAuthCode administrator credential. Local users able to traverse the SiYuan user's home path can read it and authenticate as administrator via Basic authentication, for example calling /api/system/setAPIToken to change the API token.

items.title: CVE-2026-137473
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.8.6-beta.1 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows read-only publish users (RoleReader) to modify persistent workspace configuration via /api/system/getChangelog. Attackers can send POST requests through the publish service proxy, even anonymously when basic authentication is disabled, to persist ShowChangelog = false to conf.json.

items.title: CVE-2026-137472
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.6.2 before 3.8.10 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin token holders to read files outside the workspace because the globalCopyFiles and workspaceCopyFiles denylist omits /home, /mnt, /media, and /snap. Attackers can copy other users' SSH authorized_keys, Docker and AWS configs, or mounted files into the workspace and retrieve them via the getFile API.

items.title: CVE-2026-137471
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability where WebDAV sync error formatting skips HTML escaping for certain malformed-response errors, passing raw markup to the Electron notification renderer. A network attacker who alters a cleartext HTTP WebDAV response can inject event-handler markup that, when the victim manually starts sync, executes JavaScript with Node integration as the logged-in user.

items.title: CVE-2026-137470
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers by storing handler-named block attributes such as onmouseover. Attackers can share crafted .sy.zip packages or Markdown files whose attributes reach renderCustom or the unsanitised preview pane, executing OS commands via Node integration in the desktop app.

items.title: CVE-2026-137469
items.summary: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.11 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AI agent chat panel, which renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without HTML sanitisation. Attackers influencing model replies via indirect prompt injection or a configured model endpoint can inject event-handler markup, executing OS commands through Node.js integration in desktop local-kernel mode.

items.title: CVE-2026-137464
items.summary: ImageMagick 7.0.0 before 7.1.2-35 and before 6.9.13-60 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the distributed pixel cache server, which transmits pixel and metadata content in cleartext. Attackers who can observe traffic between a DPC client and server can read transmitted image data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137461
items.summary: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in cert_write_server_certificate_v1() that computes the proprietary certificate signature over a freed stream buffer after reallocation. Clients negotiating Standard RDP Security with many static channels against servers using 3072- or 4096-bit keys trigger freed heap reads, producing invalid certificate signatures.

items.title: CVE-2026-137460
items.summary: FreeRDP from 3.10.0 before 3.33.0 contains an invalid free vulnerability in rdg.c because the websocket context pointer shares a union with chunked transfer-encoding decoder state. A malicious RD Gateway answering the data channel with chunked encoding can control the overwritten pointer via chunk sizes, causing rdg_free to free an attacker-influenced value and crash the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-137459
items.summary: FreeRDP 2.11.2 before 3.33.0 contains unbounded resource consumption in the Progressive codec because progressive_decompress() resets the tile update batch only when frameId changes. A malicious RDP server can repeat RDPGFX_CAPROGRESSIVE WireToSurface2 commands with a constant frameId to cause unbounded memory growth, quadratic CPU cost, a heap out-of-bounds write on tile-cache allocation failure, and client crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137453
items.summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to obtain client passwords because rdp_write_info_packet() omits a Remote Credential Guard check. When a victim connects using /remoteGuard with a configured /p password, the client sends the password in the Client Info packet after CredSSP, exposing reusable credentials to the destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-137403
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /admin/update_food.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument price can lead to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: CVE-2026-137404
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file food-search.php of the component Food Search. The manipulation of the argument Search leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-71409
items.summary: GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher.c. Due to the use of an unchecked sprintf() call when appending the STY environment variable to the global SocketPath buffer. The vulnerability occurs when GNU screen is executed in an environment where the HOME and STY environment variables contain attacker-controlled values that are sufficiently long. Successful exploitation may result in an application crash or potentially arbitrary code execution. This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-137578
items.summary: FacturaONE para WooCommerce con VeriFactu before 5.61 contains an authenticated SQL injection vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject SQL through the fone_client_id user meta value. Attackers can store a payload in their own profile via FONE_update_tarifa_user(), which FONE_product_ids_ocultos_para_usuario() concatenates unquoted, enabling time-based blind extraction of password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137576
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust disk space by uploading files to the POST /data/import route. Attackers without import permission can repeatedly upload input_file payloads that are stored in storage/app/temp and parsed before permission checks, never deleted, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137573
items.summary: KodeRover Zadig before 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in aslan environment kube.go handlers that allows authenticated users to query Kubernetes clusters of other projects. Attackers can supply arbitrary clusterID and namespace values to /api/aslan/environment/kube/ routes to enumerate namespaces, nodes, deployments, workloads, canary mappings, and resource names.

items.title: CVE-2026-137566
items.summary: Argo Workflows 3.0.0 through 3.7.18, 4.0.0 before 4.0.12, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the S3, GCS, and Azure Blob artifact drivers. Attackers who can write bucket objects or supply malicious artifact sources can use object keys containing ../ sequences to write arbitrary files in the executor pod, achieving code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-62272
items.summary: Relative Path Traversal vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_lambda (ExAws.Lambda module) allows an attacker to redirect an AWS Lambda control-plane request at an unintended resource by injecting path traversal sequences into a caller-supplied identifier. This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/lambda.ex and program routines ExAws.Lambda.add_permission/5, ExAws.Lambda.delete_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.delete_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function_configuration/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_policy/1, ExAws.Lamb…

items.title: CVE-2026-124756
items.summary: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Takashi Kitajima MW WP Form mw-wp-form allows HTTP DoS.This issue affects MW WP Form: from n/a through 5.1.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-111846
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPExperts NOWPayments for WooCommerce nowpayments-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects NOWPayments for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.4.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-132206
items.summary: The Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload fires specifically when an authenticated user with access to the Tasks admin panel applies the 'Created By' filte…

items.title: CVE-2026-130331
items.summary: The WP Statistics – Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 14.16.19 via the 'tab' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The exploitability of thi…

items.title: CVE-2026-107769
items.summary: The Fluent Forms – Customizable Contact Forms, Survey, Quiz, & Conversational Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Account Pre-Hijacking via Unverified Identifier in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.15. The vulnerability exists because the `PaymentHandler::maybeAssignTransactions()` function, registered on the `user_register` hook at priority 99, resolves the lookup email solely from the newly created user record via the `user_email` parameter with no prior verification that the registrant actually controls that address, then bulk-updates all guest transactions and submissi…

items.title: CVE-2026-120353
items.summary: The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag pas…

items.title: CVE-2026-135645
items.summary: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to File Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.4 This is due to the `delete_entry_files()` function gating file cleanup on a loose `preg_match('/signature_/', $meta_key)` substring check against the entry's meta-key rather than verifying the actual field type, which allows an ordinary Text field whose label begins with "Signature" to generate a qualifying meta-key such as `signature_1` — causing the attacker-controlled value submitted via `everest_forms[form…

items.title: CVE-2026-135027
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Kitae Park Mang Board WP mangboard allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Mang Board WP: from n/a through 2.4.9.

items.title: CVE-2026-137415
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Tencent RapidJSON up to 1.1.0. This affects the function Writer::WriteString in the library include/rapidjson/writer.h. Performing a manipulation of the argument length results in integer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 297637bc0a0f00dc504dbc1a47ebdaa577f8ae19. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

items.title: CVE-2026-110699
items.summary: Chainlit is vulnerable to a file upload block bypass in the "spontaneous_file_upload" functionality. Disabling the feature with the "enabled = false" option only affects the frontend, while the backend upload endpoints remain active and can be abused directly. An attacker with a valid session ID can send requests to these backend endpoints to upload arbitrary file types and then generate a retrieval URL that is accessible to anyone who obtains the link. This allows the attacker to serve malicious content, such as a fake login pages, from the application's trusted domain, which can be used for…

items.title: CVE-2026-137587
items.summary: LIVE555 Streaming Media before 2026.08.25 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in parseVorbisOrTheoraConfigStr() that trusts attacker-supplied 16-bit header length fields. A malicious RTSP server or crafted SDP Vorbis or Theora configuration can crash clients or leak heap memory through proxied SDP configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137577
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify any user record by supplying arbitrary record_id values to POST /data/save. Attackers can submit a save request for the ice_users module with the administrator's record_id to change their password or email and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-137575
items.summary: Listmonk 4.1.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CSV subscriber import that allows list-scoped users to overwrite subscribers outside their permitted lists. Attackers holding subscribers:import and list:manage on one list can import CSV rows with victims' emails and overwrite enabled to modify names, attributes, and list memberships.

items.title: CVE-2026-137574
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the related_fields and related_field_name routes in routes/data.php that lets authenticated users read restricted module data. Attackers can enumerate field_id values to query related module tables without Permission::checkPermission checks, reading id and name pairs such as user names from ice_users.

items.title: CVE-2026-137572
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to modify workflows by calling the workflow save and delete endpoints. Attackers can send an empty workflow array to /data/workflow/save or call DELETE /data/workflow/{id} to wipe or rewrite the module conversion workflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137570
items.summary: Open Policy Agent before 1.20.0 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability that allows local users to overwrite files by abusing the fixed OCI store path used when persistence_directory is unset. Attackers can pre-create the opa/oci temp directory with index.json or oci-layout symlinks so OPA overwrites the target files with OCI JSON using its privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137569
items.summary: Golift xtractr before 0.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction root because a strings.HasPrefix output directory check lacks separator awareness. Attackers can supply ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR, or other archives with entries like ../_evil/file to create or overwrite files in sibling directories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137568
items.summary: openFrameworks through 0.12.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ofxAndroid OFZipUtil.extract helper that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory. Attackers can supply a crafted ZIP archive with entries like ../escaped.txt to write or overwrite files with the Android application's file permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-71410

items.title: CVE-2026-137579
items.summary: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-core through 3.2.10, perform unblinded RSA private key operations in RSAKey::exponentiate(), so CRT recombination time reveals whether a decrypted RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256, or RSA1_5 value is below the prime q. Attackers who can submit JWEs can time rejections of crafted tokens to binary search q, factor the modulus, and decrypt all JWEs encrypted to that key.

items.title: CVE-2026-137564
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 (and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10) do not check the key length in JWEBuilder and JWEDecrypter for direct (dir) encryption, so undersized keys are zero-padded. Anyone holding a token issued with a half-size AES-CBC-HMAC key can decrypt it, and an empty key also allows forging tokens the decrypter accepts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137562
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-137561
items.summary: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10, contain a token malleability flaw because JWEDecrypter does not reject a non-empty JWE Encrypted Key with the dir, ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS algorithms, which the authentication tag does not cover. Attackers holding one token can fill the Encrypted Key with arbitrary bytes to derive unlimited distinct token strings that still decrypt, bypassing replay caches, single-use registries or revocation deny-lists keyed on the token string.

items.title: CVE-2026-137558
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 contain a decryption oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSAOAEP(), which accepts a JWE Encrypted Key made of multiple RSA blocks instead of a single RSAES-OAEP ciphertext. Attackers holding the recipient's public key can embed a captured encrypted key among crafted blocks and, using an accepted AES-CBC-HMAC algorithm and a decryption success signal, recover its CEK byte by byte to decrypt the captured JWE.

items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133209
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.

items.title: CVE-2026-133207
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-133206
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an advertiser can put XML syntax in fields of its own video creative. Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-133205
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager can supply another agency's advertiser or website identifier as a report scope and obtain that entity's name in an XLS report header. Submitted scope identifiers are not checked against the manager's permitted selections. The demonstrated disclosure is limited to entity names.

When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. items.title: Windows NTLM Security Update Causes Authentication Failures in Third-Party Apps and Devices
items.summary: Microsoft has confirmed that Windows security updates released on or after November 10, 2026, can cause authentication failures in some third-party applications and devices that rely on NT LAN Manager (NTLM). Affected products can include authentication proxy servers, single sign-on (SSO) solutions, and application packaging tools. Microsoft documented the issue in KB5135557 after rolling out […] The post Windows NTLM Security Update Causes Authentication Failures in Third-Party Apps and Devices appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform .

items.title: vouch-proxy
items.summary: an SSO and OAuth / OIDC login solution for Nginx using the auth_request module

items.title: log-analyzer
items.summary: 🛡️ log-analyzer Find attacks in your server logs in seconds: brute force, scanners, SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, Log4Shell and more, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. A small blue-team tool I wrote while learning cybersecurity. Point it at a web access log or an SSH auth.log and it tells you who attacked, how, whether it worked, and which MITRE ATT&CK technique it was, as a terminal report, JSON, or a one-file HTML page. Pure Python standard library: no installs, runs anywhere Python 3.9+ does. Quick start bash git clone https://github.com/urstrulyrammukesh/log-analyzer.git cd log-analyzer python…

items.title: Debian 12のカーネル6.1.192でBluetooth管理プロセスの再起動ループ、PC停止の報告も
items.summary: Debian 12のカーネル更新後にBluetoothの管理プロセスが再起動を繰り返し、PCが停止する事例も出ている。原因候補は脆弱性CVE-2025-21969への修正で、DebianはLinuxの開発側に調査を求めた。

items.title: DrupalのCVE-2026-136716、前回修正後も一部サイトに乗っ取りの危険。悪用確認
items.summary: Drupalで実際に悪用されている新たな脆弱性が公表された。前回の修正を適用した稼働中のサイトも条件によっては影響を受ける。追加の更新に加え、前回の勧告以降にインストーラーを外部公開していたサイトでは侵害の痕跡を調べる必要がある。

items.title: Apache TomcatのCVE-2026-133325、クラスターのTLS-PSK認証に重大な脆弱性。TLS 1.2を推奨
items.summary: Apache TomcatのTLS 1.3と事前共有鍵を使うクラスター通信に認証の不備が見つかった。修正版は11月26日時点で未公開であり、開発元は対象環境でTLS 1.2への切り替えを推奨している。

items.title: Windowsの壁紙アプリを装うSYS010、ブラウザー管理を悪用。Chrome拡張機能にメール削除機能
items.summary: 無料壁紙アプリを装うSYS010のWindows向け配布が確認された。Chrome、Edge、Firefoxの組織向け管理機能などが悪用され、Chrome向け不正拡張機能にはGmailやOutlookのメールを読み取り、削除する機能もある。

items.title: FIFAがサイバー攻撃を受け、個人情報と業務情報の一部への不正アクセスを確認
items.summary: 国際サッカー連盟（FIFA）は保有する個人情報と業務情報の一部に第三者が不正にアクセスしたことを認めた。法執行機関を含む関係当局と連携している。

items.title: Intel NUCでWinRing0検出、削除した関連ドライバ1.0.0.38をWindows Updateが再提示
items.summary: 第11世代Intel NUCの実機検証でMicrosoft Defenderが脆弱なドライバを検出。関連パッケージを削除してもWindows Updateが同一版を再提示し、実際に取得できた。2025年8月にも再インストールの報告があった。

items.title: Backblaze、広告目的での個人情報の販売・共有を明記。保存ファイルは対象外と説明
items.summary: クラウドバックアップのBackblazeがプライバシーポリシーを改訂する。過去12か月に広告目的で販売または共有した個人情報の区分を開示し、保存ファイルは広告事業者などへの販売・共有の対象外と説明した。

items.title: ピーチの顧客情報が漏えい、契約終了後もKARTEに削除対象データが残存
items.summary: ピーチは11月26日、以前利用していたプレイドのサービスKARTEから顧客情報が漏えいしたと発表した。契約終了後も削除すべきデータが残っていた。四国電力でも退会済みの会員などの情報流出が新たに判明した。

items.title: 英国の入国審査システムHelios、誤情報の訂正体制に不備。内務省をけん責
items.summary: 英国の入国審査システムHeliosの導入時、誤った個人情報を現場から訂正につなげる手続きが整っていなかった。データ保護当局のICOは内務省の法令違反を認定し、誤情報による不当な拘束や入国拒否の危険を指摘した。

items.title: EUチャットコントロール恒久法案、議長国が議会の会派トップとの協議を計画か
items.summary: 児童性的虐待対策を巡るEUの恒久法案の交渉が難航している。欧州議会の担当報告者との妥協を他会派の交渉担当者が支持せず、議長国アイルランドは会派トップを協議に加える方針を示したとされる。私的な通信の検査条件と対象範囲が争点になっている。

items.title: AIが通話中に詐欺の兆候を検知、家族にも通知する電話アプリ「みやブルフォン」提供開始
items.summary: BBSSが特殊詐欺対策電話アプリ「みやブルフォン」の提供を始めた。AIが通話内容をリアルタイムで解析し、詐欺の可能性を検知すると通話中の本人と事前に登録した家族などに知らせる。離れて暮らす家族も状況確認に加われる。

items.title: Syncthing、同期相手の探索を分散化する案。対応可能なPCも探索を支える
items.summary: ファイル同期ソフトSyncthingでDHT（分散ハッシュテーブル）による端末探索の分散化が提案された。中央の探索サーバーへの依存を減らし、サーバー役を担えるPCなども探索網を支える設計を示している。

items.title: BeeStation OS 1.5.6-68000を段階配信、保存ファイルに関わる重大な脆弱性を修正
items.summary: SynologyがBeeStation OS 1.5.6-68000の段階配信を開始した。ファイルの不正な読み書きやサービス停止につながるおそれのある脆弱性を修正しており、利用者は適用済みのOSのバージョンを確認しておきたい。

items.title: Bitwarden 2026.11.0の拡張機能でログイン・自動入力に不具合。ロック連動を一時停止
items.summary: Bitwardenはブラウザー拡張機能の一部利用者でログインや保管庫のロック・解除、自動入力に不具合が生じていることを認めた。修正が用意できるまでアプリ間のロック連動機能を停止した。利用者からは症状が続く例も報告されている。

items.title: Character.AIの会話履歴を含む資産売却計画、米司法長官42人が異議
items.summary: 破産手続き中のCharacter.AI運営会社の資産売却計画に米41州とワシントンD.C.の司法長官が異議を申し立てた。利用者の私的な会話やAIの学習用データも売却対象に含まれ、買い手に個人情報の保護義務を課すよう求めている。

items.title: 国内のダークパターン対策、解約妨害の規制を検討。行政のAI活用も提案
items.summary: 意図しない定期購入や解約の妨害を防ぐため、国内でダークパターンへの規制強化が検討されている。企業が自社サイトを点検するAI診断ツールの開発も進められているという。

items.title: 東京都の子育て支援QUOカードPayで残高減少、利用不能分を再発行へ
items.summary: 東京都の出産・子育て応援事業で、ポイントと交換したQUOカードPayの一部が使えなくなったり残高が減ったりする事象が確認された。都は対象者の未使用分に相当するデジタルコードを再発行する方針で、委託先への不正アクセスの影響も調べている。

items.title: 日本政府、先端AIの安全確保と報告の義務化を検討。命令違反には罰則も
items.summary: 日本政府が高性能AIを提供する事業者への規制を検討している。安全確保措置や国への報告を義務付け、命令違反には罰則を科す案が示された。規制対象の線引きや安全性の評価方法を巡り、AI企業からも提案が出ている。

items.title: Dasharo v1.1.8/v0.9.6、MSI PRO Z690-A/PRO Z790-Pの起動障害を修正、Secure Bootを既定で有効に
items.summary: 3mdebがMSI製マザーボード向けのオープンソースファームウェアDasharoを更新した。起動やストレージ認識の問題を修正し、DDR4のXMPを改善するとともに、Secure Bootなどの保護機能を初期設定で有効にした。

items.title: スイス当局、AIエージェントによるサイバー攻撃を国内で初確認。重要インフラ事業者にも被害
items.summary: スイス当局が国内で初確認したAIエージェント利用のサイバー攻撃では、重要インフラ事業者を含む被害組織のITシステムが侵害された。イタリア当局も大規模な侵害活動を確認。両国は外部公開システムの早期更新を勧告した。

items.title: サツドラの個人情報流出、委託先の開発環境で誤公開。アクセス記録にも欠落
items.summary: サツドラの顧客情報がサイバーエージェントの開発環境から流出した。システム移行時のファイルの誤配置に加え、公開領域の定期点検が不十分だった。公開期間の一部についてはアクセス記録も残っていない。

items.title: 生成AIの採用推薦に不要な個人属性、東京科学大学などが開示リスクを検証
items.summary: 生成AIは個人情報の開示の細かさに関する制限を守りながら、依頼された仕事には不要な情報を出力することがある。東京科学大学と理化学研究所の研究者らが採用推薦や融資などを題材に検証し、情報の必要性を独立して評価する手法を示した。

items.title: Microsoft Storeでマルウェア導入用アプリ配信、Microsoftは当初の通報に規約違反なしと回答
items.summary: Microsoft Storeで配信されたSetup Assistantがマルウェアの導入に使われていた。Microsoftは通報に規約違反なしと回答。11月26日、日本・米国・カナダを指定したWeb版URLで製品ページが表示されなかった。

items.title: 1Password、従業員のGitHubアカウント侵害で一部顧客情報流出。保管庫へのアクセスは確認されず
items.summary: パスワード管理サービスの1Passwordで一部顧客の氏名やメールアドレス、一部の招待・復旧用トークンなどが流出した。暗号化された保管庫そのものへのアクセスは確認されておらず、利用者には不審な連絡への警戒が呼びかけられている。

items.title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Vulnerability Discovery in Windows Kernel Binaries

items.title: Condition-Triggered Cryptographic Asset Control via Dormant Authorization Paths
items.summary: arXiv:2603.07933v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Control of encrypted digital assets is traditionally equated with permanent possession of private keys, a model that precludes regulatory supervision, conditional delegation, and legally compliant transfer at the cryptographic layer. Existing remedies (multi-signature schemes, threshold signatures, smart contracts, custodial delegation) require persistent key exposure, on-chain state mutation, or trusted intermediaries. items.title: A comprehensive survey of deep face verification systems adversarial attacks and defense strategies
items.summary: arXiv:2611.33231v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Face Verification (FV) systems have exhibited remarkable performance in verification tasks and have consequently garnered extensive adoption across various applications, from identity duplication to authentication in mobile payments. However, the surge in popularity of face verification has raised concerns about potential vulnerabilities in the face of adversarial attacks. items.title: VulCPE: Context-Aware Cybersecurity Vulnerability Retrieval and Management
items.summary: arXiv:2505.13895v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dynamic landscape of cybersecurity demands precise and scalable solutions for vulnerability management in heterogeneous systems, where configuration-specific vulnerabilities are often misidentified due to inconsistent data in databases like the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). Inaccurate Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) data in NVD further leads to false positives and incomplete vulnerability retrieval. items.title: Shadows in the Code: Exploring the Risks and Defenses of LLM-based Multi-Agent Software Development Systems
items.summary: arXiv:2511.18467v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems has significantly streamlined software developing tasks, enabling users with little technical expertise to develop executable applications. While these systems democratize software creation through natural language requirements, they introduce significant security risks that remain largely unexplored. items.title: VA-DAR: A PQC-Ready, Vendor-Agnostic Deterministic Artifact Resolution for Serverless, Enumeration-Resistant Wallet Recovery
items.summary: arXiv:2603.02690v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Serverless wallet recovery must balance portability, usability, and privacy. Public registries enable decentralized lookup but naive identifier hashing leaks membership through enumeration. We present VA-DAR, a keyed-discovery protocol for ACE-GF-based wallets that use device-bound passkeys for day-to-day local unlock while supporting cross-device recovery using only a user-provided identifier (e.g., email) and a single recovery passphrase. items.title: HFIPay: Privacy-Preserving, Cross-Chain Cryptocurrency Payments to Human-Friendly Identifiers
items.summary: arXiv:2603.26970v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Human-friendly identifiers such as email addresses and phone numbers are convenient payment targets, but direct mappings from identifiers to blockchain addresses make balances and transaction histories enumerable by anyone who knows the identifier. We present HFI-Pay, a relay-assisted protocol for privacy-preserving identifier-routed cryptocurrency payments. items.title: IntentMiner: Intent Inversion Attack via Tool Call Analysis in the Model Context Protocol
items.summary: arXiv:2512.14166v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Agentic AI has established the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the standard for connecting reasoning engines with external tools. items.title: AESP: A Human-Sovereign Economic Protocol for AI Agents with Privacy-Preserving Settlement
items.summary: arXiv:2603.00318v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As AI agents increasingly perform economic tasks on behalf of humans, a fundamental tension arises between agent autonomy and human control over financial assets. items.title: Architecture-Agnostic Feature Synergy for Universal Defense Against Heterogeneous Generative Threats
items.summary: arXiv:2603.14860v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generative AI deployment poses unprecedented challenges to content safety and privacy. However, existing defense mechanisms are often tailored to specific architectures (e.g., Diffusion Models or GANs), creating fragile "defense silos" that fail against heterogeneous generative threats. items.title: Better Batches, Better Privacy: Random Allocation for DP-BandMF
items.summary: arXiv:2610.12712v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The current state of the art for batch selection and noise addition in differentially private training is a combination of DP Banded Matrix Factorization (DP-BandMF; informally, DP-SGD where the noise added in two different steps can be correlated if the steps are within $b$ of each other) and privacy amplification by sampling via Monte Carlo accounting. items.title: Hardware-Aware Model Inversion in Memristive Spiking Neural Networks
items.summary: arXiv:2610.39688v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hardware-accelerated spiking neural networks (SNNs) implemented on memristive crossbar arrays offer significant gains in energy efficiency, while device variability and analog noise are sometimes assumed to hinder information extraction. However, whether these hardware effects improve, preserve, or degrade privacy after deployment remains largely unexplored. items.title: Sketching for First Order Method: Efficient Algorithm for Low-Bandwidth Channel and Vulnerability
items.summary: arXiv:2210.08371v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sketching, which randomly compresses a large problem into lower dimensions to save runtime and memory, is a fundamental tool in large-scale machine learning. We propose a sketching scheme for first order methods in distributed learning that reduces the communication cost per round between agents, keeps our bound on the total communication no larger than for uncompressed distributed gradient descent, and still guarantees convergence. items.title: Protecting Confidentiality, Privacy and Integrity in Collaborative Learning
items.summary: arXiv:2412.08534v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A collaboration between dataset owners and model owners is needed for effective machine learning (ML) training. items.title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
items.summary: arXiv:2611.25509v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment.
